title: 第一卷 第29章 要赚大钱
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
薛凤说道：“哟，真是长大了，会说话哄嫂子高兴了。”

    李华：“实话。”

    薛凤：“是谁前几天还觉得饭菜不可口，你哥说了你两句，你就摔筷子。”

    李华挠挠头。

    有这事？

    那指定有。

    他说道：“我之前不懂事，太混蛋了。”

    “以后不会了。”

    薛凤笑着说道：“行，浪子回头金不换，改天回家也和妈说说，让她也高兴高兴。”

    李华点头。

    薛凤往外走。

    李华送了几步，说道：“嫂子，天黑了，路上慢点。”

    薛凤回头摆摆手，露出欣慰的笑，小叔子是真的不一样了，以前的李华可绝对不会说出这话来。

    走了几步。

    遇到滕千琴，笑着打招呼。

    滕千琴问道：“这是遇到什么好事，高兴成这样？”

    薛凤说道：“就高兴。”

    李华也忍不住笑，心想嫂子呐，这才哪到哪就高兴成这样，等他赚了大钱，那得高兴成啥样啊。

    到时候让全村人都另眼相瞧，好好的给咱一家人长脸。

    他想着。

    心里那是干劲十足。

    和滕千琴打了个招呼，转身进屋。

    看着床上铺好的床单，心里暖和和的。

    哥嫂对他真是没话说，爸走得早，大哥十几岁就出去做工赚钱养家，俗话说，长兄如父，大哥也是真把他当儿子养。

    嫂子更没话说。

    要不是上一世他太混蛋，害了一家不得安宁，侄子侄女又怎么可能和他老死不相往来。

    薛凤回到家里。

    李文看李华没跟着回来，脸色立刻拉了下去。

    薛凤赶紧把李华说的话学了一遍。

    老娘任琴诧异：“他真这么说的？”

    薛凤笑道：“这些话，你让我编，我也编不出来啊。”

    李文冷哼：“现在漂亮话倒是会说了。”

    “看他接下来咋样吧。”

    薛凤说道：“我看阿华真变了。”

    任琴说道：“要真和你说的那样就好了。”

    “也能省点心。”

    ……

    第二天一早。
content_en:
Xue Feng said: "Oh, I have grown up so much. I can talk and make my sister-in-law happy."

    Li Hua: "Truth."

    Xue Feng: "Who thought the food was unpalatable a few days ago? Your brother said a few words to you and you threw your chopsticks."

    Li Hua scratched his head.

    Is this happening?

    That means there is.

    He said: "I didn't understand before, I was such an asshole."

    "Not anymore."

    Xue Feng said with a smile: "Okay, the prodigal son will never be replaced by gold. I will talk to my mother when I go home another day, so that she will be happy too."

    Li Hua nodded.

    Xue Feng walked out.

    Li Hua took a few steps away and said, "Sister-in-law, it's dark, please go slower on the road."

    Xue Feng turned around and waved his hands, showing a pleased smile. His brother-in-law was really different. The former Li Hua would never say this.

    Take a few steps.

    When I met Teng Qianqin, I smiled and said hello.

    Teng Qianqin asked: "What good thing happened to you, so you are so happy?"

    Xue Feng said: "I'm just happy."

    Li Hua couldn't help but laugh, thinking to his sister-in-law, how happy she is now, how happy she will be when he makes a lot of money.

    When the time comes, let the whole village look at us differently and make our family look good.

    he thought.

    In my heart, I was very motivated.

    He said hello to Teng Qianqin and turned around to enter the house.

    Looking at the sheets on the bed, I feel warm in my heart.

    His brother and sister-in-law really had nothing to say to him. His father passed away early, and his eldest brother went out to work when he was a teenager to earn money to support the family. As the saying goes, an elder brother is like a father, and his eldest brother really raised him as a son.

    My sister-in-law has nothing to say.

    If he hadn't been such a bastard in the last life and brought trouble to the whole family, how could his nephews and nieces have been separated from him forever.

    Xue Feng returned home.

    When Li Wen saw that Li Hua didn't follow him back, his expression immediately dropped.

    Xue Feng quickly learned what Li Hua said.

    My mother, Ren Qin, was surprised: "Did he really say that?"

    Xue Feng smiled and said: "If you ask me to make up these words, I can't make them up."

    Li Wen snorted coldly: "Now I know how to say nice things."

    "Let's see what happens next."

    Xue Feng said: "I think Ah Hua has really changed."

    Ren Qin said: "It would be great if it was really what you said."

    "It also saves some worry."

    …

    Early the next morning.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 29 Want to Make Big Money
